from pathlib import Path
import re
text=Path('/workspaces/semio/compose/js/sketchpad/Sketchpad.tsx').read_text()
# rough class parser by brace counting from 'class Name'
for m in re.finditer(r'\bclass\s+(\w+)\b', text):
    name=m.group(1)
    start=text.find('{', m.end())
    if start==-1: continue
    depth=0
    i=start
    while i < len(text):
        c=text[i]
        if c=='{': depth+=1
        elif c=='}':
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:
                end=i
                break
        i+=1
    else:
        continue
    body=text[start:end+1]
    uses='this.hash(' in body
    defines=('hash =' in body) or re.search(r'\bhash\s*\(', body) is not None
    if uses and not defines:
        line=text[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
        print(name, 'line', line)
